messages:
Maya: Quick async check-in for the staged rollout of priority-routing-v2. Started canary slice A at ~3%. What I did: kicked off the canary, ran smoke tests, and opened the primary dashboards. Blockers: none right now. Today: monitor for 45m then consider bump to 10% if stable.

OpsBot: DeployBot: Canary rollout initiated for feature `priority-routing-v2` -> 3% (slice A). Deploy ID: deploy-2026-03-17-21.

Devon: Saw a short ~5m error spike in infra-queue latency about +40s after the rollout. Looks like cache warmup causing a backlog, not user-facing 5xx. I'll keep an eye, adding more logs.

Lia: Can you paste the feature flag config you used? Also what are the automatic rollback criteria? @Santiago can you confirm alert thresholds so ops knows when to page?

Santiago: Rollback rules: auto-rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency regresses by >200ms vs baseline for 5m. Manual rollback if session error rate >0.3% for 10m. Ops will be paged on both.

Maya: ff config (prod):
```
flags:
  priority_routing_v2: 3%
  slices:
    - name: slice-A
      pct: 3
```
Curl to bump to 10% (ops/dev only):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-internal/flags/priority_routing_v2/update" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"pct":10}'
```

Devon: I'll instrument extra trace IDs on the outbound calls and open a quick PR for the cache prefill change — should help the warmup spike. PR here: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/932 (WIP).

Raj (PM): Quick product note: if we get to 50% today and metrics look stable, we can start customer comms for beta users. If we stall at 3% or 10%, hold communications. I'll sync with growth after EOD.

Lia: Observability update: added a small dashboard tile for slice-A heatmap and a p95 comparison widget pinned to the rollout timeframe. Shared dashboard link in #eng-ops.

OpsBot: Alert (informational): transcode-service p95 increased by +120ms in slice-A at +12m. Current p95 is within the configured temporary threshold. No paging.

Devon: That aligns with cache warmup. I'm adding a prefill task to the deploy job so next rollout warms caches beforehand. For now, recommend holding at 3% until the prefill PR merges.

Maya: Ack — holding at 3% for now. If no regressions in next 45m we'll bump to 10%. @Devon please post PR merge link when done. :thumbsup:
